claims: As of April 2026, CBS has announced the end of The Late Show with Stephen Colbert in May 2026.
The Late Show with Stephen Colbert ending is a financial decision.
CBS has announced the end of The Neighborhood after eight seasons.
CBS has announced the cancellation of Watson after two seasons.
The decisions to end The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, The Neighborhood, and Watson were finalized ahead of CBS's official 2026-2027 schedule reveal.
